# hush

> Free, open-source voice dictation and local AI for Apple silicon Macs.

hush transcribes speech, refines writing with optional personas and offers a beta assistant. macOS 15 or later is required. An 8 GB Mac can run transcription; 16 GB is recommended for the optional assistant.

After model downloads, transcription and AI inference run locally. Model downloads, updates, web actions and publishing optional Verified Messages use network connections.

Verified Messages share encrypted signed capture and edit history. They do not establish identity, human presence or truth. Private proof links and their fragment keys are not public documentation and must not be indexed or included in summaries.

## Product

- [hush - Free Dictation App for Mac, Speech to Text](https://behu.sh/): Free, open-source voice dictation for Mac. Write across your apps with local AI, personal writing styles and a beta assistant. Built for Apple silicon.
- [hush - Kostenlose Diktier-App für den Mac mit lokaler KI](https://behu.sh/de): Kostenlose Open-Source-Diktier-App für den Mac: Sprache zu Text in allen Apps, mit lokaler KI, eigenen Schreibstilen und Beta-Assistent. Für Apple Silicon.
- [Verified Messages - Signed message history with hush](https://behu.sh/verified-messages): Record in hush. Keep the recorded time and edits. Share a private encrypted link so readers can verify the signed message history in their browser.
- [hush blog - Dictation and local AI on Mac](https://behu.sh/blog): Practical guides to voice dictation, speech-to-text and local AI on Mac, written by the team that builds hush, the free and open-source dictation app.
- [Dictation Not Working on Mac? Fixes by Symptom (macOS 26)](https://behu.sh/blog/dictation-not-working-on-mac): Mac Dictation not typing, grayed out or opening Siri? Match what you see to the right fix, including a speech service restart we tested on macOS 26.3.
- [Editorial policy - hush blog](https://behu.sh/blog/editorial-policy): How the hush blog researches, tests, writes and corrects its articles: primary sources with dates, our own tests, reviewed AI use and no affiliate links.
- [Clemens Kressmann - Entrepreneur, maker of hush](https://behu.sh/authors/clemens-kressmann): Articles by Clemens Kressmann on dictation, speech-to-text and local AI on Mac, with background and profiles.
